delegations.scope: Wire u128 stabilization + peer compatibility hardening in handshake/sync routing
notes: Wire canonicalization: peer payload u128 fields now serialize as hex strings (0x...) while keeping backward-compatible decode for legacy decimal/u64 inputs.
Handshake classification hardening: early same-shard vs inter-shard branch with explicit guards.
Same-shard strictness: cluster_id mismatch now rejected explicitly.
Capability negotiation hardening: malformed/incompatible sync_profile now rejected with class-specific reasons.
Sync route lane reasons split: inter_shard_sync_forbidden vs same_shard_profile_mismatch.
Inbound HelloAck now propagates concrete reject reason instead of generic hello_rejected.
Docs updated: divergence implementation notes + dedicated peer compat/wire stabilization review note.
